{{was wotd|2022|January|1}}
{{wp}}
[[File:Cc-public domain mark.svg|thumb|alt=Copyright symbol (the letter C inside a circle) crossed out by a diagonal line.|'''Public Domain''' Mark]]

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|:af|public<t:able to be seen or known by everyone>|domain<t:field or sphere of activity, expertise, or influence>}}
{{af|en|public<t:able to be seen or known by everyone>|domain<t:field or sphere of activity, expertise, or influence>|type=endocentric}}.<ref>{{R:OED Online|pos=n|id=265942|date=June 2018|nodot=1}}; {{R:Lexico|pos=n}}</ref>

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpʌ.blɪk dəʊˈmeɪn/|/də-/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˌpʌ.blɪk doʊˈmeɪn/|a=GA}}
* {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Persent101-public domain.wav|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|eɪn|s=4}}
* {{hyph|en|pub|lic do|main}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun|-|abbr=PD}}

# {{lb|en|also|attributively}} {{n-g|Often preceded by {{m|en|[[in]] [[the]]}}}}:
## The [[state#Noun|state]] of not being [[own#Verb|owned]] by [[anyone]], and thus [[freely]] [[usable]] by [[everyone]].
### {{lb|en|specifically|law}} The [[realm]] of [[creative work]]s to which no exclusive [[intellectual property]] [[right]]s apply, that is, that are [[no longer]] [[protect]]ed by [[copyright#Noun|copyright]] or [[patent#Noun|patents]].
###: {{ux|en|As the copyright in this book has lapsed, it is now in the '''public domain'''.}}
###* {{quote-journal|en|date=2011-03-04|author=Séverine Dusollier|title=SCOPING STUDY ON COPYRIGHT AND RELATED RIGHTS AND THE PUBLIC DOMAIN|magazine=w:World Intellectual Property Organization|url=https://www.wipo.int/edocs/mdocs/mdocs/en/cdip_7/cdip_7_inf_2.doc
|passage=Any regime applied to the '''public domain''' should ensure such free use.  Yet, the ‘public domainness’ does not guarantee as such a freedom to access to the resources it contains. Access to a '''public domain''' work will depend on many factors.}}
## The state of not or no longer being [[confidential]] or [[secret#Adjective|secret]].
##: {{ux|en|Very little information about the treaty is in the '''public domain'''.}}
# {{lb|en|especially|US}} [[land#Noun|Land]] [[regard#Verb|regarded]] as [[own#Verb|owned]] by the [[public#Noun|public]], and not [[subject#Adjective|subject]] to a land [[patent#Noun|patent]] or other [[form#Noun|forms]] of [[private#Adjective|private]] [[ownership]] (for example, [[unowned]] [[prairie]] in the [[southwestern]] and [[western#Adjective|western]] [[United States]]).
